errors.text_span: 在每个测试集下，四种方法的WER值均呈现一致的柱高趋势：绿色柱最高，代表“无”特征时WER最高，约为35%；蓝色柱次之，约为28%；黄色柱再次之，约为25%；深绿色柱最低，约为22%。
errors.evidence: This statement inaccurately generalizes the data by claiming the bar heights are consistent across all test sets and providing single approximate values for each method. The chart clearly shows a decreasing trend in WER for all methods from Test1 to Test5. For instance, the WER for the '无' method (light green) is ~36% in Test1 but drops to ~29% in Test5, making the single approximation of '约为35%' misleading.

errors.text_span: 且各测试集之间柱高趋势保持一致
errors.evidence: This claim that the bar height trend is 'consistent' across test sets is incorrect. While the ranking of methods within each test set is consistent (无 > i-vector > d-vector > s-vector), the actual bar heights (WER values) show a clear and consistent decreasing trend from Test1 to Test5 for all methods. The description misses this important trend.
The legend is positioned at the top center of the chart, not in the top right corner.
